summary.intent: Complete and close out CipherBox phase 65 (SDK write-chain bin re-link and invite claim) by verifying all success criteria, marking the phase complete, and cleaning up todos.
summary.outcome: Phase 65 verified passed (4/4 must-haves), marked complete with STATE advanced to phase 66, one resolved todo closed, and one mis-tagged bug todo flagged for human review rather than auto-closed.

repo: Phase 65 used a D-02 mock seam for the live publish-gate (403/410 on tombstoned IPNS names); the live cutover is explicitly deferred to Phase 66 SC.

Todo frontmatter field `resolves_phase` can be mis-tagged — a bug todo tagged `resolves_phase: 65` was never fixed in phase 65 because its target files (apps/api/src/shares/*) were prohibited by D-02.
Phase completion flow: verify → mark complete → commit artifacts (ROADMAP, STATE, REQUIREMENTS, VERIFICATION.md) → close resolved todos.

code.finding: sealChildWriteKey/unsealChildWriteKey use role byte 0x04 via buildNodeAad(..., 0x04); both are barrel-exported.
Definitive security assertion: expect(readOnlyNode.writeBody).toBeUndefined() — confirms read-only holders cannot reach write signing material.
BinEntry.nodeReadKey field exists; restoreFromBin calls sealChildReadKey with no content re-encryption. grep for originalFolderKeyEncrypted and encryptedChildKeys returns 0.

workflow: Only retire bug todos that are confirmed resolved; mis-tagged todos (resolves_phase pointing to a phase that didn't fix the bug) should be flagged for human review.
Phase completion commit should bundle ROADMAP, STATE, REQUIREMENTS, and VERIFICATION.md together.
TDD gate was advisory/non-blocking in this phase; the sequence of test(65-XX) RED before feat(65-XX) GREEN was tracked manually.

friction: A todo was mis-tagged with resolves_phase: 65 for a bug (442 MB leaked pins in apps/api/src/shares/*) that phase 65 was explicitly prohibited from fixing — required manual disambiguation instead of auto-close.
open_items: WRITE-04 live publish-gate (403/410 rejection on tombstoned IPNS names) — D-02 mock seam in phase 65, live cutover is a Phase 66 success criterion.
Bin delete / empty-bin pin leak bug (~442 MB leaked pins in apps/api/src/shares/*) — high severity, mis-tagged as phase 65, actually unresolved and pending human triage.

Phase 66 (API schema cutover) is the next phase to begin.
